_about: Same-player correlation between two stats in one game, as normal scores of each stat's rank within the player's own season (Gaussian copula). NBA box scores only: regular-season games of 15+ minutes, player-seasons with 12+ such games, 2024-25 to 2026-27 (through 24 Nov 2026). Used by tools/parlay_builder.py to price two legs on one player.
